articles.body: If the Resolve Crisis event comes up and the elephant is within a company controlled territory (not on a border) how does this get resolved? I am assuming this is considered a rebellion but how is the "attackers" strength determined and what happens if they win?
articles.bodyXml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<xml><safehtml>If the Resolve Crisis event comes up and the elephant is within a company controlled territory (not on a border) how does this get resolved? I am assuming this is considered a rebellion but how is the "attackers" strength determined and what happens if they win?</safehtml></xml>

articles.body: The strength of the revolt will be equal to the "+" number written on the Crisis Event card PLUS one strength for each unrest cube in the region. If the rebellion is successful, you follow the procedure for company region loss: remove the Commander of that region's army and roll death checks for every Officer in that army (the Commander's family also loses half of their Trophies, rounded up); return any governor overlay, player family pieces and unrest cubes in that region to their respective supplies; close every order in that region; reduce company standing by 1 [u]for each region lost this turn[/u]; and, lastly, add a one-level tower (with no flag) to that region.

<?xml version="1.0"?>

If the rebellion is successful, you follow the procedure for company region loss: remove the Commander of that region's army and roll death checks for every Officer in that army (the Commander's family also loses half of their Trophies, rounded up); return any governor overlay, player family pieces and unrest cubes in that region to their respective supplies; close every order in that region; reduce company standing by 1 <span style="text-decoration: underline;">for each region lost this turn</span>; and, lastly, add a one-level tower (with no flag) to that region.</safehtml></xml>

articles.body:
Thanks Adam. What happens if the rebellion loses?  Does the company / player get a trophy? Do the unrest cubes clear off of the company controlled region? Does the elephant move with either a win or loss of the rebellion and if so does it move based on the card draw pile location in both situations?
Thanks!
articles.bodyXml:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<xml><safehtml>Thanks Adam. What happens if the rebellion loses?  Does the company / player get a trophy? Do the unrest cubes clear off of the company controlled region? Does the elephant move with either a win or loss of the rebellion and if so does it move based on the card draw pile location in both situations?<br/>Thanks!</safehtml></xml>

articles.body:
No problem!

Yes, the defending player gets a trophy if they succeed.

Yes, unrest cubes clear after you successfully defend.

Yes, whether the rebellion was successful or not, the elephant will move to the region depicted on the top of the draw deck, crossing the border that matches the icon (circle, triangle..) depicted on the Crisis card.
